items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the village law, in relation to the application of certain provisions of law relating to non-resident members of the village of Blasdell volunteer fire department
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S7011

TITLE OF BILL:  An act to amend the village law, in relation to the
application of certain provisions of law relating to non-resident
members of the village of Blasdell volunteer fire department

PURPOSE:

This bill allows the percentage of non-resident volunteer members to
exceed forty-five percent of the actual membership of the village fire
department of Blasdell, New York.

SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 amends subdivision 7 of section 10-1006 of the village law
which forbids the percentage of non-resident volunteer members in
village fire companies to exceed forty-five percent of the actual
membership of the fire company. The amendment exempts the village of
Blasdell, New York volunteer fire department from the requirements of
subdivision 7.

Section 2 states that this law shall take effect immediately.

JUSTIFICATION:

Currently, village law forbids the percentage of non-resident
volunteer members in village fire companies to exceed forty-five
percent of the actual members fire company. This negatively impacts
village fire companies by making it more difficult to fill their total
membership and leaving fire companies with vacancies which could be
filled by the membership of non-resident volunteer firefighters. This
bill allows the percentage of non-resident volunteer members to exceed
forty-five percent of the actual membership of the village of Blasdell
volunteer fire department. This will help the fire department obtain
greater membership and keep its community safer.

LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New bill.

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None

EFFECTIVE DATE:

Immediately.

summary: Provides that certain provisions of laws relating to the percentage of non-resident members of a fire company shall not apply to the village of Blasdell volunteer fire department.
